literal: If suspicion was not divided and reason not exhausted, one should not let officials of the three pure ranks and nine currents die under the staff at once, lightly cutting off life, harming reason and ruining law.
idiomatic: If suspicion was not divided and reason not exhausted, officials of the three pure ranks and nine currents should not die under the staff at once, lightly cutting life and ruining law.

literal: In years past in the province he flogged five men to death in the great market; on checking the bandits' case there was not a inch of truth.
idiomatic: Years past in the province he flogged five to death in the great market; checking the bandits' case, not an inch of truth.

literal: Now again cruel harm reaches this.
idiomatic: Now again cruel harm reaches this.

literal: Court and countryside murmur alike, all hold alarm.
idiomatic: Court and countryside murmur; all hold alarm.

literal: If life and death lie below and cruelty is monopolized by a subject, where is the ruler's power again used?
idiomatic: If life and death lie below and cruelty is monopolized by a subject, where is the ruler's power used?

literal: Ask that the present matter be given to the Court of Justice for investigation, verifying the robbery case and examining the beating-to-death reason.
idiomatic: Ask that the present matter go to the Court of Justice, verifying robbery and examining beating to death.

literal: An edict followed it.
idiomatic: An edict followed.

literal: In office Cheng avoided nothing.
idiomatic: In office he avoided nothing.

literal: He also memorialized eight articles on the system of granting and receiving reclaimed land, very coherent.
idiomatic: He memorialized eight articles on granting and receiving reclaimed land, very coherent.

literal: The West
idiomatic: The West

literal: Yezhada, Persia, and other states, each on public embassy, all sent Cheng one fine horse.
idiomatic: Yezhada, Persia, and other states on embassy each sent Cheng one fine horse.

literal: Cheng asked they be given to the Imperial Stud to fill the state herds.
idiomatic: Cheng asked they be given to the Imperial Stud for state herds.

literal: An edict said: "The king's integrity exceeds the Chu minister; order them to the stables to complete the gentleman's great beauty."
idiomatic: An edict said, "The king's integrity exceeds the Chu minister; order them to the stables to complete the gentleman's great beauty."

literal: Censor-in-Chief Prince of Dongping Kuang memorialized asking to take from Jingming year onward internal and external examination registers, Ministry of Personnel appointment documents, Central Military merit records, and all grade rankings, intending to compare and verify men who stole rank and office.
idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Prince of Dongping Kuang asked registers from Jingming onward—examinations, appointments, merit records, grade rankings—to verify men who stole rank.

literal: Empress Dowager Ling permitted it.
idiomatic: Empress Dowager Ling permitted it.

literal: Cheng memorialized that "the censor's body is to hear wind and report.
idiomatic: Cheng memorialized that "the censor's body is to hear wind and report.

literal: As for false merit and reckless rank, each has its place of distinction.
idiomatic: False merit and reckless rank each have their place.

literal: If in one place there is wind-rumor, one should seize that one register and investigate truth and falsehood.
idiomatic: If in one place there is rumor, seize that register and investigate truth.

literal: If the difference is not the same, fraud shows itself; then apply the statutes—who will not submit?
idiomatic: If difference shows, fraud shows itself; then apply statutes—who will not submit?

literal: How can one move one ministry's affairs and exhaust a generation's faults—seeking fault thus, who can bear the crime?
idiomatic: How move one ministry's affairs and exhaust a generation's faults—seeking fault thus, who bears the crime?

literal: This is truly what the sage court should heavily caution.
idiomatic: This is what the sage court should heavily caution.

literal: Empress Dowager Ling accepted it and stopped.
idiomatic: Empress Dowager Ling accepted and stopped.

literal: Later he was transferred to Minister of Works; palace attendance and leading the Masters of Writing were as before.
idiomatic: Later he was minister of works; palace attendance and leading the Masters of Writing unchanged.

literal: At the time the empress dowager was keen on construction; in the capital she raised Yongning, Grand Supreme Duke, and other Buddhist temples at no small cost; outer provinces each built five-story pagodas.
idiomatic: The empress dowager was keen on construction; in the capital she raised Yongning and other temples at great cost; outer provinces each built five-story pagodas.

literal: Again and again she held universal fast assemblies; gifts in motion reached tens of thousands.
idiomatic: Again and again she held universal fasts; gifts reached tens of thousands.

literal: The people were worn by earth-and-wood labor; gold and silver prices leaped.
idiomatic: The people were worn by earth and wood; gold and silver prices leaped.

literal: Officials' salary strength was stripped; the treasury was drained.
idiomatic: Officials' salaries were stripped; the treasury drained.

literal: She also bent gifts to those at her side—several thousand a day.
idiomatic: She also bent gifts to those at her side—several thousand a day.

literal: Cheng memorialized at length on gain and loss.
idiomatic: Cheng memorialized at length on gain and loss.

literal: Though in the end it was not followed, she always answered with courteous favor.
idiomatic: Though not followed in the end, she always answered with courteous favor.

literal: Policy great and small all drew his participation.
idiomatic: Policy great and small drew his participation.

literal: Cheng also gave his heart to support and correct; what was not convenient for the people he surely admonished again and again; inside and outside all respected and feared him.
idiomatic: Cheng gave his heart to support; what harmed the people he admonished again and again; inside and outside respected and feared him.

literal: Yi, styled Zilun, was born of stepmother Lady Feng and had much of his father's manner.
idiomatic: Yi, styled Zilun, born of stepmother Lady Feng, had much of his father's manner.

literal: He was made Unimpeded Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary.
idiomatic: He was made Unimpeded Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary.

literal: When Yuan Cha monopolized power Yi was ashamed to cling to him and therefore did not win prominent office.
idiomatic: When Yuan Cha monopolized power Yi was ashamed to cling and did not win prominent office.

literal: At the start of Emperor Zhuang he was killed at Heyin.
idiomatic: At the start of Zhuang he was killed at Heyin.

literal: Posthumously given Equal in Honor to the Three Excellencies and Inspector of Qingzhou; posthumous title Wen.
idiomatic: Posthumously given Equal in Honor to the Three Excellencies and inspector of Qingzhou; posthumous title Wen.

literal: Yi's elder brother by a concubine, Shun, styled Zihe.
idiomatic: Yi's elder brother by a concubine, Shun, styled Zihe.

literal: At nine he took Master Chen Feng of Le'an as teacher; he first copied several thousand words of Wang Xizhi's Elementary Primer, reciting day and night; in fifteen days he penetrated all.
idiomatic: At nine he took Chen Feng of Le'an; he copied Wang Xizhi's Elementary Primer, several thousand words, reciting day and night; in fifteen days he penetrated all.

literal: Feng marveled at him.
idiomatic: Feng marveled.

literal: He told Cheng: "From fifteen I followed teachers to white-haired age; what eye and ear have passed I have never seen the like—Jiangxia's yellow boy cannot be without a pair.
idiomatic: He told Cheng, "From fifteen I followed teachers to white hair; never seen the like—Jiangxia's yellow boy cannot be without a pair.

literal: Cheng smiled: "Lantian produces jade—how could it not be so.
idiomatic: Cheng smiled, "Lantian produces jade—how could it not be so.

literal: At sixteen he mastered the Du clan Spring and Autumn; he lowered the curtain and read, his will fixed on loving antiquity.
idiomatic: At sixteen he mastered the Du clan Spring and Autumn; he lowered the curtain to read, loving antiquity.

literal: By nature he was blunt and startled, indifferent to glory and profit, fond of wine, skilled at the zither.
idiomatic: Blunt and startled by nature, indifferent to glory, fond of wine, skilled at zither.

literal: He often long-chanted and sighed, entrusting his song to an empty room.
idiomatic: He often long-chanted and sighed, entrusting song to an empty room.

literal: Under Xuanwu he submitted the Wei Way Eulogy; much of the text is not recorded.
idiomatic: Under Xuanwu he submitted the Wei Way Eulogy; much is not recorded.

literal: He began office as Court Gentleman of the Imperial Clan.
idiomatic: He began as Court Gentleman of the Imperial Clan.

literal: At the time Gao Zhao held power; men of the realm bowed in the dust.
idiomatic: Gao Zhao held power; men bowed in the dust.

literal: Shun once carried a calling card to Zhao's gate; the gatekeeper, seeing him young, answered: "Inside sit many great guests."
idiomatic: Shun carried a calling card to Zhao's gate; the gatekeeper, seeing him young, said, "Inside sit many great guests."

literal: He would not announce him.
idiomatic: He would not announce him.

literal: Shun rebuked him: "Can the son of Prince of Rencheng be base?
idiomatic: Shun rebuked him, "Can the son of Prince of Rencheng be base?

literal: On meeting he went straight to the couch, took his hand in equal courtesy; kings and dukes who came first all marveled and feared;
idiomatic: On meeting he went straight to the couch with equal courtesy; kings and dukes marveled;

literal: yet Shun's words were proud, as though he saw no one.
idiomatic: yet Shun's words were proud, as though he saw no one.

literal: Zhao told the gathered guests: "This boy's spirit is still so—how much more his father!
idiomatic: Zhao told guests, "This boy's spirit is still so—how much more his father!

literal: When he left Zhao added respect and saw him off.
idiomatic: When he left Zhao added respect and saw him off.

literal: Cheng heard and was greatly angry; he caned him several tens of blows.
idiomatic: Cheng heard and was greatly angry; he caned him tens of blows.

literal: Later he was made Junior Master of Rites; he left office for his father's mourning, weeping until he vomited blood, carrying earth on his own back.
idiomatic: Later junior master of rites; he left for his father's mourning, weeping until he vomited blood, carrying earth himself.

literal: At twenty-five he already had white hair; when mourning ended he plucked it and it did not grow again—the age thought it filial thought's doing.
idiomatic: At twenty-five he had white hair; when mourning ended he plucked it and it did not grow—the age thought filial thought.

literal: Soon he was made Attendant of the Yellow Gate.
idiomatic: Soon he was made Attendant of the Yellow Gate.

literal: At the time Commander of the Guards Yuan Cha's power was especially great; whenever there was transfer or appointment none failed to visit his gate and pay court.
idiomatic: Commander of the Guards Yuan Cha's power was especially great; on transfer none failed to visit and pay court.

literal: Shun only submitted a memorial; he never called on Cha.
idiomatic: Shun only submitted a memorial; he never called on Cha.

literal: Cha said to Shun: "How can you simply not see me?
idiomatic: Cha said, "How can you simply not see me?

literal: Shun said with stern face: "The Son of Heaven is rich in spring years and entrusts government to clan helpers; uncle should take utmost fairness as heart and raise men to repay the state.
idiomatic: Shun said sternly, "The Son of Heaven is young and entrusts government to clan helpers; uncle should take fairness as heart and raise men for the state.

literal: How sell favor and demand private thanks—is that what is hoped?
idiomatic: How sell favor and demand private thanks—is that what is hoped?

literal: On court debate of gain and loss Shun often spoke straight and correct and never bent to intent.
idiomatic: On court debate Shun often spoke straight and never bent.

literal: Therefore he was feared and sent out as Inspector of Hengzhou.
idiomatic: Therefore he was feared and sent out as inspector of Hengzhou.

literal: Shun told Cha: "The northern garrisons are in turmoil and are the state's thorn—grant me overall command as the state's screen.
idiomatic: Shun told Cha, "Northern garrisons are in turmoil, the state's thorn—grant me overall command as screen.

literal: Cha's heart suspected difficulty and did not wish to give him a military post; he told Shun: "This is the court's affair—not mine to decide.
idiomatic: Cha suspected and did not wish to give a military post; he said, "This is the court's affair—not mine to decide.

literal: Shun said: "Uncle already holds life and death in his hand and says the heavenly mandate should be on my person—how can there still be a court?
idiomatic: Shun said, "Uncle holds life and death and says the mandate should be on me—how can there still be a court?

literal: Cha grew ever more angry and feared him.
idiomatic: Cha grew angrier and feared him.

literal: Transferred to Inspector of Qizhou.
idiomatic: Transferred to inspector of Qizhou.

literal: Shun, confident in his talent, could not stay within and constantly nursed resentment, showing it in face and speech.
idiomatic: Confident in talent, he could not stay within and nursed resentment in face and speech.

literal: He then drank for pleasure and did not mind government.
idiomatic: He drank for pleasure and did not mind government.

literal: Cha was removed from commanding the guards; Shun was summoned as Attendant of the Yellow Gate.
idiomatic: Cha was removed from the guards; Shun was summoned as Attendant of the Yellow Gate.

literal: Kin and friends met him at the suburbs, congratulating that he had entered.
idiomatic: Kin met him at the suburbs, congratulating entry.

literal: Shun said: "I do not fear not entering—only fear entering and then leaving again.
idiomatic: Shun said, "I do not fear not entering—only fear entering and leaving again.

literal: Soon he held the Palace Directorate concurrently; transferred to Palace Attendant.
idiomatic: Soon he held the Palace Directorate; transferred to palace attendant.

literal: At first Prince of Zhongshan Xi raised troops to attack Yuan Cha and failed and was executed.
idiomatic: Prince of Zhongshan Xi raised troops against Yuan Cha, failed, and was executed.

literal: When Empress Dowager Ling returned to government, burial could at last be changed.
idiomatic: When Empress Dowager Ling returned to government, burial could be changed.

literal: Shun sat in attendance at the Western Tour Garden and memorialized to the empress dowager: "Yesterday I went to view Prince of Zhongshan's burial—not only kin mourned his unjust suffering; travelers and commoners seeing one house with ten dead all wore green mourning flags and none did not weep sourly.
idiomatic: Shun sat in the Western Tour Garden and told the empress dowager, "Yesterday I viewed Prince of Zhongshan's burial—not only kin mourned; travelers seeing ten dead in one house wore green flags and wept.

literal: Cha's wife was then at the empress dowager's side; Shun pointed and said: "How can Your Majesty for one younger sister's sake not subdue Yuan Cha's crime and let the realm harbor injustice?
idiomatic: Cha's wife was at her side; Shun pointed. "How for one younger sister not subdue Yuan Cha and let the realm harbor injustice?

literal: The empress dowager was silent and did not speak.
idiomatic: The empress dowager was silent.

literal: De Xing of Yingzhou rebelled; Director of the Masters of Writing Lu Tong was sent to campaign and returned in great defeat.
idiomatic: De Xing of Yingzhou rebelled; Lu Tong was sent to campaign and returned in great defeat.

literal: It happened that Palace Attendant Mu Shao sat with Shun; they discussed Tong's crime.
idiomatic: Palace Attendant Mu Shao sat with Shun; they discussed Tong's crime.

literal: Tong had earlier borrowed a nearby residence from Shao; Shao wished somewhat to speak for him.
idiomatic: Tong had borrowed a nearby residence from Shao; Shao wished to speak for him.

literal: Shun suddenly said: "Lu Tong in the end will be without crime!
idiomatic: Shun suddenly said, "Lu Tong in the end will be without crime!

literal: The empress dowager said: "How can it be as the attendant says?
idiomatic: The empress dowager said, "How can it be as the attendant says?

literal: Shun said: "Tong gave a fine house to a powerful attendant—why worry about crime?
idiomatic: Shun said, "Tong gave a fine house to a powerful attendant—why worry about crime?

literal: Shao was ashamed and dared not speak again.
idiomatic: Shao was ashamed and dared not speak.

literal: Empress Dowager Ling was much given to adornment and often went out on tours; Shun remonstrated to her face: "By rites, a woman who loses her husband calls herself the not-yet-dead; she removes pearl earrings and does not wear colored dress.
idiomatic: Empress Dowager Ling adorned herself and often toured; Shun remonstrated, "By rites a widow calls herself not-yet-dead, removes pearls, wears no colored dress.

literal: Your Majesty mothers all under heaven and nears forty—excessive adornment, how show it to later ages?
idiomatic: Your Majesty mothers the realm and nears forty—excessive adornment, how show later ages?

literal: Empress Dowager Ling was ashamed and returned inside; she summoned Shun and reproached him: "I summoned you a thousand li—did you wish to shame me before the crowd?
idiomatic: She was ashamed and returned; she summoned Shun. "I summoned you a thousand li—did you wish to shame me before the crowd?

literal: Shun said: "Your Majesty in splendid dress dazzles the realm and does not fear the world's laughter—why shame yourself at one word of mine?"
idiomatic: Shun said, "Your Majesty dazzles the realm and does not fear laughter—why shame at one word of mine?"

literal: At first Prince of Chengyang Hui admired Shun's talent and name and favored him especially.
idiomatic: Prince of Chengyang Hui admired Shun's talent and favored him.

literal: But Prince of Guangyang Shen通 Hui's wife Lady Yu and a great rift opened.
idiomatic: But Prince of Guangyang Shen通 Hui's wife Lady Yu—a great rift opened.

literal: When Shen was summoned from Dingzhou and entered as Director of the Ministry of Personnel with concurrent command of the central guards, Shun drafted the edict, the wording quite beautiful.
idiomatic: When Shen was summoned from Dingzhou as director of the Ministry of Personnel with central guards, Shun drafted the edict, wording beautiful.

literal: Hui suspected Shun was Shen's man at court; therefore with Xu Chi he slandered Shun to Empress Dowager Ling.
idiomatic: Hui suspected Shun was Shen's man; with Xu Chi he slandered Shun to the empress dowager.

literal: Shun was sent out as Grand General Who Protects the Army and Grand Master of Rites.
idiomatic: Shun was sent out as Grand General Who Protects the Army and grand master of rites.

literal: Shun took leave in the Western Tour Garden; Hui and Chi attended at the side.
idiomatic: Shun took leave in the Western Tour Garden; Hui and Chi attended.

literal: Shun pointed and told Empress Dowager Ling: "This man is Wei's Bo Pi—if Wei is not destroyed he will not die.
idiomatic: Shun pointed and told her, "This man is Wei's Bo Pi—if Wei is not destroyed he will not die.
